title: Stock device templates from the reference sets and a unit-converting parameter patcher
description:
## Intent

Stock device templates and a parameter patcher.

## Steps

- `crates/apricity-daw/templates/devices/*.xml`: each device used (EQ Eight, Compressor, Limiter, Saturator, Redux, Gate, Utility, Reverb, Delay, Auto Filter), extracted from the M0 reference `devices.als`, at default values; loaded with `include_str!`.
- `crates/apricity-daw/src/devices/mod.rs`: set a parameter by name in the score's units, converting to the set's stored value (real or normalized) per `design/daw-set.md`; fresh ids per instance.
- Unit tests: each conversion round-trips within tolerance; a template instance passes the set checker.

## Verification

`CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw devices`.

## Release

`feat(<this task's id>): stock device templates for DAW sets`. Not breaking.
